feeding_claim.verbatim: It is 100% grassfed, and 100% grass finished on our lush, chemical free pastures.

farmers_markets: Old Capital Farmers Market, Springfield, IL (Saturdays 8 am to 12:30 pm, year round)

pickup_locations: Pre-order pickup at the farmers markets it attends

notes: Family farm at Jacksonville in central Illinois, started in 2016. Checked 2026-11-15 the about, products, find us and contact pages. Cattle never get grain, only pasture and farm-raised hay in winter; beef is 100% grass fed and grass finished. Chickens have grazing pasture and eggs are sold as pasture raised. Orders through a Barn2Door store, with delivery to Jacksonville, Springfield and Bloomington, pre-order pickup at the farm (visits scheduled ahead) and at the Old Capital Farmers Market in Springfield; the monthly meat box has free delivery. Beef, chicken and eggs are carried by stores in Springfield, Jacksonville, Chatham, Ashland and Bloomington (several Hy-Vee stores take eggs only) and used by four restaurants. No phone, shipping or bulk beef found. Also sells garden produce. The site calls the farm organic; organic labels are left to the USDA matching script.
